metrics.name: total_python_lines
metrics.reason: Keep src, scripts, and tests in one visible Python-growth budget so generated production code and shallow regression-test bulk cannot hide from review; the 200-line steady-state limit admits the ordinary +12-to-+166-line run observed across merged PRs #526-#535 with 34 lines of measured headroom while requiring a merge-base- and measured-content-bound, reviewed exception for the +435 and +511 large batches.

metrics.name: radon_b_ranked_blocks
metrics.reason: Keep the calibrated B-ranked complexity inventory from growing while stricter thresholds remain under review.

metrics.name: radon_worst_complexity
metrics.reason: Prevent the worst measured control-flow complexity from regressing between governed revisions.

metrics.name: interrogate_coverage_percent
metrics.reason: Do not reduce the measured public/module documentation inventory while documentation thresholds are calibrated.

entry_schema.base_sha: 40-character lowercase effective comparison base SHA (the measured merge base)
entry_schema.head_python_content_fingerprint: 64-character lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of all tracked Python blobs at the measured head; avoids self-reference while invalidating the exception when any measured Python content changes
